description: This file defines API endpoints for event management and recommendations within a FastAPI application. It includes functions for creating, listing, retrieving specific events, and fetching recommendations based on event IDs.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: Router object from FastAPI used to define a group of related API routes.

classes.name: EventRequest
classes.description: Schema model representing the data required to create an event.

classes.name: EventResponse
classes.description: Schema model representing event data returned to clients.

classes.name: RecommendationResponse
classes.description: Schema model encapsulating recommendations for an event.

classes.name: ScoredOption
classes.description: Model representing an option with an associated score.

methods.name: EventResponse create_event(payload: EventRequest, repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo))
methods.description: Creates a new event, storing it in an in-memory repository.

methods.name: List[EventResponse] list_events(repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo))
methods.description: Returns a list of all stored events.

methods.name: EventResponse get_event( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event by its ID, raising 404 if not found.

methods.name: RecommendationResponse get_recommendations( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
methods.description: Generates mock recommendations for a specific event, including scored options.

ctags.signature: ( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )

ctags.signature: ( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
